Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Yes — and without building anything: the sidecar is already the eval log. Every run records reviewer findings, accepted-vs-rebutted outcomes, passes to gate green, open threads at review time, and signoff decision+note, all timestamped. Phase 4 is now 'dogfood as eval': 3-5 real docs, read the metrics off the sidecars with jq (signal ratio, passes needed, threads faced), then SET the cap and budget from those traces. The 2/~5 in Phase 2 are now explicitly provisional defaults pending that. If the jq version proves too thin, a proper eval harness becomes its own research/plan.
